description: Is a local worker up, which model and revision it is serving, free RAM, and which verifier tools this project has. Call it before a run: everything else here needs a worker, and a missing stryker or muter is why a verdict would fail for a reason that is not the test's fault.

project.description: the project being verified — tsc/vitest/stryker are reported from its node_modules, not sidecrew's

name: sidecrew_status
